scope: Pure derived TRAIN targets, no exact solves or network training
prefix_value_semantics: Total original-state complete-protocol Q, not residual value after prefix execution
normalization: divide by max(original decision H,1), including prefix value
policy_loss: negative log total probability assigned to optimal_next set
advantage: q_next minus maximum q_next; every optimal action has zero advantage
sampling: uniform state within its fold, then uniform nonterminal prefix within state; action loss averaged within prefix
terminal_decoding: END only, policy loss masked; STOP at empty prefix only
folds: metadata-only salted hash order; floor(groups/4) validation groups, at least one if groups >=2
